subject: Hospitality
title: César Ritz: The King of Hoteliers
description: A fast breakdown of César Ritz: The King of Hoteliers for builders.

hook.text: César Ritz was fired from his first hotel job for being 'hopeless.' He went on to define luxury hospitality forever.

buildup.text: Ritz obsessed over details—flower arrangements, lighting angles, the exact temperature of dining rooms.

discovery.text: He opened the Ritz Paris in 1898 with private bathrooms in every room—unheard of at the time. It set the new standard.

twist.text: The word 'ritzy' entered English directly from his name. One hotelier became an adjective for luxury itself.

climax.text: Ritz's philosophy was simple: anticipate what guests want before they know they want it. Service, not servitude.

punchline.text: Fired as hopeless, became a synonym for luxury. That's a comeback.

quiz.question: What innovation did the Ritz Paris introduce in 1898?
